card.name: The word sword
card.fires_on: The word "sword" (or "swords"), whether a literal weapon in history, myth or fiction or the idiom "double-edged sword". It also fires weakly on the "ord" piece inside "sordid".

modes.label: Literal weapon
modes.description: A sword as an object carried, made, or used by a person or character.
modes.example: His armour was said to have been made for him by Hephaestus, at the request of his mother; and his<< sword>> was shown in the temple of Ascle

modes.label: Double-edged sword idiom
modes.description: "Sword" ending the phrase "double-edged sword", used for something with both good and bad effects.
modes.example: Thus, TNF-α is a double-edged<< sword>>. Like TNF-α, inflammation
